Field Manual, Chapter 12.2., Instructions for Calculating Liquid Petroleum Quantities Measured by Turbine or Displacement Meters, First Edition, September 1981 (ANSI/API MPMS 12.2F-1981)

The field manual to Chapter 12.2 provides instructions to individuals charged with calculating metered petroleum quantities without detailed explanations of why a particular course of action is necessary. 35 pages. Price each, $10.00
